name: mdreview
description: Human-in-the-loop document review for agents. Push a markdown or LaTeX draft, a person comments in the browser, and Claude reads the comments and revises.
long_description: mdreview lets Claude hand a draft to a person and get structured feedback back. Claude creates a review from markdown (or LaTeX) and returns a link. The reviewer opens it in the browser and leaves comments anchored to specific phrases. Claude reads the open comments, applies the edits, replies to or resolves each thread, and hands the turn back. Reviews live on https://app.mdreview.space and need an mdreview agent token from your account page.

token.title: mdreview agent token
token.description: An mdr_ token from https://app.mdreview.space/account (Agent tokens).

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Create a review from markdown or LaTeX and get the review link.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List your reviews with status, comment counts and revision.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Get one review's metadata.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Read a review's current draft.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Read the reviewer's notes and comments on a review.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Cheap poll for changes to a review's source, feedback and comments.

tools.name: update_source
tools.description: Push a revised draft; the reviewer's page reloads.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: List a review's past rounds, or fetch one past draft with its feedback.

tools.name: get_git_url
tools.description: Get a git clone URL with one commit per review round.

tools.name: delete_review
tools.description: Delete a review and its data.

tools.name: attach_asset
tools.description: Attach an image so the viewer renders it in the draft.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List the images attached to a review.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Leave a comment anchored to a quoted phrase in the draft.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comment threads, optionally only the open ones.

tools.name: get_comment
tools.description: Read one comment thread with all replies and status history.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Reply to a comment without resolving it.

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark a comment resolved once it has been addressed.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment and its thread.

tools.name: hand_back
tools.description: Hand the turn back to the reviewer after acting on feedback.

tools.name: ping_working
tools.description: Renew your claim on a review while you work on it.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Report the running server's name, version and tool list.

prompts.name: review-draft
prompts.description: Send a draft to a person for review in the browser.
prompts.text: Write a first draft about ${arguments.topic}, create an mdreview review from it, and give me the review link so I can comment.

prompts.name: apply-feedback
prompts.description: Read the open comments on a review and revise the draft.
prompts.text: Check my mdreview reviews for open comments, apply the requested edits with update_source, reply to or resolve each comment, and hand the review back.

prompts.name: review-status
prompts.description: See which reviews are waiting on you or on the reviewer.
prompts.text: List my mdreview reviews and tell me which ones have new feedback for you to act on.
